name: Chicken Waldorf Salad with Yogurt Dressing & Romaine Lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in a small saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove from liquid and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together yogurt, lemon juice, honey, mustard, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
juice of 1 ½ lemon
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add walnuts and, stirring constantly, toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash apples, celery, grapes, and chives. Core, medium dice, and add apples to bowl with dressing. Trim ends, medium dice, and add celery to bowl. Halve grapes and add to bowl. Chop chives and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
6 sticks celery
0.341 kg red grapes
1 ½ small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 2 ½ cm strips.
Pat dry the chicken with paper towels, medium dice, and add to bowl. Toss salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce leaves on a plate and top with salad. Enjoy!
